textRuns.value: Tips: Cash flow uses a disconnected one-level Lines role and model-supplied CF Actual/Budget/Prior measures. Select contiguous periods for bridge checks; the sample does not invent missing-period movement. Formatting and variance rules come from cash-flow line metadata. Use Shift+F10/right-click for Power BI context menu and configured drillthrough; refresh the inline sample model before saving the final PBIX.
